stem: A held propagation tray is mistakenly moved toward a clean area. What should Technician I do?
choices: Continue because the tray is already moving
Mix the tray with clean stock
Stop the movement, restore the controlled boundary as procedure requires and report the deviation
rationale: Stop the movement, restore the controlled boundary as procedure requires and report the deviation. This preserves the Course 005 identity, crop-care, scouting, biosecurity, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
